summary: Iteration 3 backend + frontend regression. Restored missing postgres data dir (initdb, sar_crop DB, PostGIS ext, init.sql schema) — then backend came up as 'PostGIS (canonical)'. All 40 pytest tests pass (test_engine, test_storage_postgis, test_mvp_api, test_regression_iter3). Frontend flows verified: admin login, dashboard (55.2% flood, 271.99 ac, 4 alerts, HIGH severity, map polygon), run SAR analysis (system-notice, chart, trend-signals), sentinel run no-files (53.5%, HIGH, DEMO SAR, 4 artifact rows), PDF download, click-to-draw map with vertex count 0→4, undo→3, clear→0, invalid JSON polygon shows field-polygon-error, save/edit/delete field, logout, mobile 390x844 shows mobile-logout-button and farmer tools + draw map.

minor.issue: RuntimeWarning: invalid value encountered in cast still emitted by numpy during sentinel/PDF path (backend.err.log server.py:130). NaN-safe conversion in raster.png_preview may still hit a nan->uint8 cast when scaled has NaNs and lo==hi. Not a functional break (tests pass) but the iteration goal was zero warnings.

ui_bugs.issue: Artifact thumbnails render as broken images (naturalWidth=0/None) because is fetched by the browser without the Authorization header and the artifact endpoint requires Bearer auth. Data itself is available (backend returns 200 image/png with auth).

action_items: Fix sentinel artifact auth: either serve artifacts through a short-lived signed URL / cookie, expose an unauthenticated static path for public DEMO artifacts, or fetch via fetch()+Authorization and set as blob URL in SentinelTools.js so thumbnails render in the browser.

Eliminate remaining 'RuntimeWarning: invalid value encountered in cast' by masking NaNs before .astype('uint8') in raster.png_preview (e.g. np.where(np.isfinite(scaled), scaled, 0).clip(0,255).astype('uint8')) and guard the lo==hi / all-NaN branch.

Container fork lost the postgres data directory (/var/lib/postgresql/15/main was gone and the 'postgres' OS user missing). Add an idempotent bootstrap (useradd postgres, initdb, create sar user + sar_crop DB, run backend/sql/init.sql) into a startup hook so the backend does not silently fall back to MongoDB after a reset.
critical_code_review_comments: Environment fragility: PostGIS is now canonical, but if the OS user or data dir is missing the backend logs 'PostGIS unavailable, falling back to MongoDB' and keeps running with a different store — the /api/ storage banner is the only surface signal. Consider failing fast (or a health endpoint that returns non-200) when the configured canonical store is unavailable, so silent MongoDB fallback in production is not possible.

Sentinel artifact endpoint requires Bearer auth but the SentinelTools component renders plain — inherently broken in-browser without an interceptor. Either loosen auth for DEMO artifacts (they are public demo pixels) or fetch as blob.
JWT is still in localStorage; playbook check for httpOnly cookie session is unmet (carried over from iter 2).
updated_files: /etc/passwd (created postgres user), /var/lib/postgresql/15/main (initdb), postgres role + sar_crop DB + init.sql applied. No app source files modified.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (1 known non-blocker: artifact auth)

seed_data_creation: Registered a couple of TEST_iso_* farmers during ownership isolation tests (safe to leave, as noted in agent-to-agent context). TEST_UI_Field created via UI was deleted at end of run. TEST_Square/TEST_Square2/TEST_Cleanup fields are created and deleted within their own tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PostGIS bootstrap: sudo useradd -r -s /bin/bash -d /var/lib/postgresql postgres; chown -R postgres /var/lib/postgresql /etc/postgresql /var/log/postgresql; sudo -u postgres /usr/lib/postgresql/15/bin/initdb -D /var/lib/postgresql/15/main; cp /etc/postgresql/15/main/{postgresql,pg_hba}.conf into the data dir; then CREATE USER sar PASSWORD 'sar' SUPERUSER; CREATE DATABASE sar_crop OWNER sar; psql -d sar_crop -f /app/backend/sql/init.sql. After that, supervisorctl restart postgres backend. Regression: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=$(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | cut -d= -f2) python -m pytest tests -q. Frontend flows all pass at desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x844. The only user-visible frontend issue is broken sentinel artifact thumbnails due to missing Authorization header on .
rca of the issue: Two environmental problems and two application-level nits. (1) Container fork removed /var/lib/postgresql/15/main and the 'postgres' OS user, so supervisord could not start postgres, backend then either fell back to Mongo or the ingress returned 502 while backend was restarting; fixed by initdb + sar_crop DB + init.sql. (2) After PostGIS was up all 40 backend tests passed deterministically (flood 55.2%, area 271.99 ac). (3) Sentinel artifact tags call GET /api/sentinel1/results/{run_id}/{filename} which requires Bearer auth, but the browser tag cannot attach the token; result: broken thumbnails in SentinelTools. (4) RuntimeWarning: invalid value encountered in cast is still logged during raster png rendering (raster.py:47 nan_to_num + astype uint8 path or the lo==hi branch).
